description: Intel-internal GNR PMT telemetry overview organized by use case and architecture domain, with strict units and full Explorer drill-down.

links.title: Bilingual Dashboard Guide
links.tooltip: Panel semantics, units, caveats and unresolved items

panels.title: 00 · Customer Overview
panels.description: Four immediately readable signals. Technical collection quality, topology and provenance are kept in the final sections.

panels.title: PMT Data
panels.description: Ready means the selected OOB or in-band path has PMT series and its newest sample is no older than 45 seconds.

panels.title: Peak Core Temperature
panels.description: Maximum valid current core temperature. Disabled 0°C placeholders are excluded. No artificial warning or fault threshold is applied.

panels.title: C-Die FIVR
panels.description: Project convention: Healthy means all exposed two-bit slots are zero and available; any non-zero slot is Unhealthy.

panels.title: QAT Activity
panels.description: Active requires measured QAT PCIe traffic. Idle is expected for CPU-only workloads and does not mean collection failed.

targets.expr: (vector(1) and on() (sum(rate(label_replace({__name__=~"qat[01]_tl_bw_(in|out)_megabytes_total",PMTEndpoint="$endpoint",CollectionMode="$path",DeviceId=~"$socket"},"metric","$1","__name__","(.+)")[5m:])) > 0)) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(rate(label_replace({__name__=~"qat[01]_tl_bw_(in|out)_megabytes_total",PMTEndpoint="$endpoint",CollectionMode="$path",DeviceId=~"$socket"},"metric","$1","__name__","(.+)")[5m:])) == 0)) or vector(-1)

panels.title: 01 · Core Environment & Activity
panels.description: Current thermal and relative activity fields. AGG[D/A/S] locates the Aggregator; Core N is the XML/HELP field number and is not a Linux CPU number.

panels.title: Current Thermal Hotspots
panels.description: Top 12 valid current temperatures. AGG[D/A/S] identifies the source Aggregator, followed by the XML HELP core number.

panels.title: Temperature for Core $local_core
panels.description: Temperature history for XML field Core $local_core in each selected CORE Aggregator; 0°C disabled placeholders are excluded.

panels.title: PMT Relative Activity
panels.description: Rate of the experimental U64.38.26 relative-usage counter. Six decimal places are retained; this is not CPU utilization percent.

panels.title: Throttle Events · Last 5 Minutes
panels.description: Top five-minute event-count increases for the 64-cycle and 1024-cycle observation families. A non-zero value does not identify thermal, power or VR root cause.

panels.title: 02 · Core Operating Profile
panels.description: Five-minute residency distributions for the selected XML Core field in the selected CORE Aggregator scope; these are not instantaneous readings.

panels.title: Frequency Residency
panels.description: Share of valid residency-counter growth in the last five minutes; buckets below 0.1% are hidden.
